BL-619 — Morning briefing leads with a warning when projected token burn outruns the weekly reset
Approval context: Two calls to sanity-check, one genuine ruling. (a) The anchor design: since the account percentage is not programmatically readable, the projection anchors on a number you transcribe from the app via one CLI line; stale/no anchor degrades to local-burn-only rather than guessing. Cheapest honest opt…
BL-619 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-619" (or "reject BL-619 <reason>") to act.
